title: Crown and Thorn
author: Ada Dunmore
blurb: Zephyrine Dunmore, a debt-bound temple scribe, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
